name: Master Learner
body:
You immediately master a skill which you recently began studying.

Prerequisite(s): Instant mastery (Loremaster secret), Skill Focus (see benefit), Int 15, Loremaster level 3rd

Benefit: When you take this feat, choose a skill which you used the instant mastery secret to learn your initial ranks in and which you have improved with the Skill Focus feat. By taking this feat you immediately gain enough ranks in the skill to increase it to your current maximum number of ranks, just as if you had spent skill points on it.
